title: Pipkin's Wobbly Garden
markdown:
Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, lived a little rabbit named Pipkin. Pipkin loved his garden! One bright morning, he planted baby marigolds in a perfect circle.

“Hooray!” he chirped. “Sunshine flowers!”

Suddenly, Tilly the kitten zipped by.

“Your baby plants are like sunbeams! May I plant one too?”

Tilly gently placed her little plant near some yummy catnip. Plink!

Then, Ivy the hedgehog peeked out.

“Your flowers are so bright! May I add one?”

Ivy softly put her baby plant by a juicy strawberry. Plonk!

Next, Miss Clover the badger ambled over.

“What a happy sight! May I offer a baby plant?”

Miss Clover placed hers near a buzzing bumblebee. Plop!

Pipkin looked. His perfect circle wasn’t a circle anymore! It was a happy wiggle! Tilly’s flower leaned towards the catnip. Ivy’s peeked at the strawberry. Miss Clover’s waved to the bee.

Tilly giggled.

“It’s not a circle, Pipkin! It’s a happy wiggle!”

Ivy rustled.

“Or a wonderful wobble!”

Miss Clover chuckled.

“Everyone added their own special touch of happiness!”

Pipkin looked again. He saw Tilly’s flower where a kitten loves to play. He saw Ivy’s flower by the sweet strawberries. He saw Miss Clover’s flower by the busy bee. They weren’t in a neat circle, but they all reached for the sun.

“You know what?” Pipkin grinned. “It’s the most beautiful, wobbly, happy garden I’ve ever seen!”

Tilly, Ivy, and Miss Clover agreed. Their wonderfully wobbly garden shone in the sun, plink, plonk, and plop, all together.
